module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  x,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] y;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            y <= 3'b000;
            z <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case ({y, x})
                6'b000000: begin y <= 3'b000; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b000010: begin y <= 3'b001; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b000100: begin y <= 3'b010; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b001000: begin y <= 3'b001; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b001010: begin y <= 3'b010; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b001100: begin y <= 3'b001; z <= 1'b1; end
                6'b010001: begin y <= 3'b001; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b010011: begin y <= 3'b011; z <= 1'b1; end
                6'b010100: begin y <= 3'b100; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b011001: begin y <= 3'b001; z <= 1'b0; end
                6'b011011: begin y <= 3'b011; z <= 1'b1; end
                6'b011100: begin y <= 3'b100; z <= 1'b1; end
                default:   y <= 3'bx; z <= 1'bx;
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  clk,
  input  reset,
  input  x,
  output reg z
);
  reg [2:0] y;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      y <= 3'b000;
      z <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case (y)
        3'b000: begin z <= 1'b0; if (x) y <= 3'b001; else y <= 3'b000; end
        3'b001: begin z <= 1'b0; if (x) y <= 3'b100; else y <= 3'b001; end
        3'b010: begin z <= 1'b0; if (x) y <= 3'b001; else y <= 3'b010; end
        3'b011: begin z <= 1'b1; if (x) y <= 3'b010; else y <= 3'b011; end
        3'b100: begin z <= 1'b1; if (x) y <= 3'b100; else y <= 3'b100; end
        default: begin z <= 1'b0; y <= 3'b000; end
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input x, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] y, next_y;
  always @(*) begin
    case (y[2:0])
      3'b000: begin z=1'b0; next_y = (x) ? 3'b001 : 3'b000; end
      3'b001: begin z=1'b0; next_y = (x) ? 3'b100 : 3'b001; end
      3'b010: begin z=1'b0; next_y = (x) ? 3'b001 : 3'b010; end
      3'b011: begin z=1'b1; next_y = (x) ? 3'b010 : 3'b011; end
      3'b100: begin z=1'b1; next_y = (x) ? 3'b100 : 3'b100; end
      default: begin z=1'b0; next_y = 3'b000; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) y <= 3'b000;
    else       y <= next_y;
  end
endmodule
